description: One position (or pre-aggregated bucket) in a duration-cell x sector grid, for one period and one side (portfolio or benchmark).

cell.description:
Duration-cell label, such as `"5.0-5.5"` for a duration bucket.
Any string key is accepted independently of how cells were built.

sector.description: Sector bucket label within the cell.

total_return.description: Realized total return for the period (decimal).

weight.description: Weight as a fraction of the whole side at period start (decimal).

title: GridPosition
